entities.summary: The Villa della Regina is a once semi-rural palace, now surrounded by the city of Turin, Piedmont, Italy. It is located at Strada Santa Margherita #79 in the eastern sector of the city, in the quarter of Borgo Po. It was originally built by the House of Savoy in the 17th century.
